name: CMS Donors Editor - The Supporter Identity Fields
description: The Donors editor with the four fields The Momentum Network draws a supporter node from — School, Class year, Location, and Why I gave — filled in on a new entry. Reached by driving the form rather than by URL, because the CMS renders the new-entry editor in place; the fills also scroll the new block into a viewport-sized frame, which is the only way it lands above the fold. Note what the frame does and does not prove: School renders as a DROPDOWN rather than the text box a free-text field would give, but it reads '— none —' because a native select option cannot be committed through the capture harness's verbs. That the dropdown offers exactly the thirteen schools resolveSchool accepts is asserted in src/lib/selectOptions.test.ts, which is a durable check rather than a screenshot of an open menu.

interactions.value: I got my first board seat through someone I met at a Harvard in Tech dinner. This is how I pay that forward.
